The '''Multiphasic duo-diode relay''' was technology used in communications. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this type of relay was equipped on the newest [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']].

==Behind the scenes==
The mutliphasic duo-diode relay appeared in the [[2010]] novel, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''.
